title: Ukrainian Homemade Dumplings
description: These hearty, homemade Ukrainian dumplings are a comforting and delicious meal. Simply boil or pan-fry these dumplings for a satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water and egg.
Gradually add in flour, salt, and shortening; mix until dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces; roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of potato filling in the center of each circle.
Fold dough over filling and press edges to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Carefully add dumplings to boiling water and cook for 10-12 minutes.
Remove dumplings from water and serve with melted butter and cheddar cheese.
